summary: Design specification for a first-class DECISION approval scope in orchestrator/schemas/v1/approval-token.json and Engine.approve(), so owner-decision gates can be resolved through a validated token instead of manual ledger mutation.
problem: approval-token.json declares only PLAN, COMMIT, DRY_RUN, IMPORT. A gate with scope DECISION cannot be resolved: Engine.approve() requires token.scope == gate.scope, and the schema rejects DECISION. _owner_gate then refuses to resume without a validated event, leaving manual workflow_events insertion as the only transition.
